en: The image depicts a black-and-white photograph of an ornate historical building with classical architecture, including statues atop the roof and elaborate decorative features framing the windows. In front of the building, there is a substantial fountain topped by a statue, standing in a landscaped public square. Several people, dressed in old-fashioned attire indicative of the late 19th or early 20th century, are seen walking or standing around the fountain and square. Surrounding the central building are similarly styled multi-story urban buildings.
